benefits.text: hince Second Skin Airy Powder gives a natural, feather-light matte finish, keeping makeup long-lasting without caking. The product helps brighten the look of the skin tone and color-correct so the skin looks even-toned and radiant. The powder gently removes excess oil without taking away the skin's radiance and natural look. In particular, the product does not affect the makeup's sheer effect and is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

howToUse.text:
Use the puff to pick up just enough powder. Press the powder evenly over the whole face or the areas that need coverage. 
You can apply an extra layer of powder on the T-zone and chin to control excess oil and improve hold.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

shadeDescription.text: Brightens the look of dull skin, giving a fresh, bright effect with a soft lavender shade

positioning.text: Feather-light setting powder that helps set the base, blur naturally and color-correct the complexion.

sellingPoints.text: Natural, feather-light matte finish; removes excess oil without losing radiance; color-corrects the complexion, keeps makeup long-lasting.

finish.text: Natural matte / feather-light / still keeps radiance.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim absolute oil control or actual skin whitening. Use “sensitive skin” strictly according to the documentation, avoiding any promise of no irritation.
